HEADLINE: Company has received a prior intimation from Mrs. Sandhya Agarwal, belonging to the Promoter/Promoter Group of Joindre Capital Services Limited, regarding the proposed inter-se transfer ....
MORE: Company has received a prior intimation from Mrs. Sandhya Agarwal, belonging to the Promoter/Promoter Group of Joindre Capital Services Limited, regarding the proposed inter-se transfer of an aggregate of 6,50,000 equity shares of the Company, constituting approximately 4.70% of the total paid-up equity share capital of the Company.
NEWSSUB: Submission Of Prior Intimation Under Regulation 10(5) Of SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011.

HEADLINE: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''SEBI LODR''),  the Board of Directors of Company at its meeting ....
MORE:
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''SEBI LODR''),  the Board of Directors of Company at its meeting held on Friday, 30th October, 2026 considered and approved the unaudited Financial Results (both standalone and consolidated) of the Company for the quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026.

Further, pursuant to provisions of Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR, the said unaudited financial results of the Company for quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026 have been published by the Company in Free Press Journal and Navshakti on 01st November, 2026.
